_comment: Selected Work bubbles. Adding an item here adds a bubble — no code change. `href` is the Instagram permalink the bubble opens; `caption` is the post's own caption text, used for the hover label and the accessible name. Thumbnails must be local files (the page's CSS policy blocks off-site images, and Instagram doesn't allow reliable hotlinking).
